verses.text: Let God arise, let his enemies be scattered; Let them also that hate him flee before him.

segments.text: Let God arise, let his enemies be scattered;
Let them also that hate him flee before him.

verses.text: As smoke is driven away, so drive them away: As wax melteth before the fire, So let the wicked perish at the presence of God.

segments.text: As smoke is driven away, so drive them away:
As wax melteth before the fire,
So let the wicked perish at the presence of God.

verses.text: But let the righteous be glad; let them exult before God: Yea, let them rejoice with gladness.

segments.text: But let the righteous be glad; let them exult before God:
Yea, let them rejoice with gladness.

verses.text: Sing unto God, sing praises to his name: Cast up a highway for him that rideth through the deserts; His name is Jehovah; and exult ye before him.

segments.text: Sing unto God, sing praises to his name:
Cast up a highway for him that rideth through the deserts;
His name is Jehovah; and exult ye before him.

verses.text: A father of the fatherless, and a judge of the widows, Is God in his holy habitation.

segments.text: A father of the fatherless, and a judge of the widows,
Is God in his holy habitation.

verses.text: God setteth the solitary in families: He bringeth out the prisoners into prosperity; But the rebellious dwell in a parched land.

segments.text: God setteth the solitary in families:

verses.text: O God, when thou wentest forth before thy people, When thou didst march through the wilderness; [Selah

verses.text: The earth trembled, The heavens also dropped rain at the presence of God: Yon Sinai trembled at the presence of God, the God of Israel.

verses.text: Thou, O God, didst send a plentiful rain, Thou didst confirm thine inheritance, when it was weary.

segments.text: Thou, O God, didst send a plentiful rain,

verses.text: Thy congregation dwelt therein: Thou, O God, didst prepare of thy goodness for the poor.

segments.text: Thy congregation dwelt therein:

verses.text: The Lord giveth the word: The women that publish the tidings are a great host.

segments.text: The Lord giveth the word:

verses.text: Kings of armies flee, they flee; And she that tarrieth at home divideth the spoil.

segments.text: Kings of armies flee, they flee;

verses.text: When ye lie among the sheepfolds, It is as the wings of a dove covered with silver, And her pinions with yellow gold.

verses.text: When the Almighty scattered kings therein, It was as when it snoweth in Zalmon.

segments.text: When the Almighty scattered kings therein,

verses.text: A mountain of God is the mountain of Bashan; A high mountain is the mountain of Bashan.

segments.text: A mountain of God is the mountain of Bashan;
A high mountain is the mountain of Bashan.

verses.text: Why look ye askance, ye high mountains, At the mountain which God hath desired for his abode? Yea, Jehovah will dwell in it for ever.

segments.text: Why look ye askance, ye high mountains,

verses.text: The chariots of God are twenty thousand, even thousands upon thousands: The Lord is among them, as in Sinai, in the sanctuary.

verses.text: Thou hast ascended on high, thou hast led away captives; Thou hast received gifts among men, Yea, among the rebellious also, that Jehovah God might dwell with them.

verses.text: Blessed be the Lord, who daily beareth our burden, Even the God who is our salvation. [Selah

segments.text: Blessed be the Lord, who daily beareth our burden,

verses.text: God is unto us a God of deliverances; And unto Jehovah the Lord belongeth escape from death.

segments.text: God is unto us a God of deliverances;

verses.text: But God will smite through the head of his enemies, The hairy scalp of such a one as goeth on still in his guiltiness.

segments.text: But God will smite through the head of his enemies,

verses.text: The Lord said, I will bring again from Bashan, I will bring them again from the depths of the sea;

verses.text: That thou mayest crush them, dipping thy foot in blood, That the tongue of thy dogs may have its portion from thine enemies.

verses.text: They have seen thy goings, O God, Even the goings of my God, my King, into the sanctuary.

segments.text: They have seen thy goings, O God,

verses.text: The singers went before, the minstrels followed after, In the midst of the damsels playing with timbrels.

verses.text: There is little Benjamin their ruler, The princes of Judah and their council, The princes of Zebulun, the princes of Naphtali.

verses.text: Thy God hath commanded thy strength: Strengthen, O God, that which thou hast wrought for us.

segments.text: Thy God hath commanded thy strength:

verses.text: Because of thy temple at Jerusalem Kings shall bring presents unto thee.

segments.text: Because of thy temple at Jerusalem

verses.text: Rebuke the wild beast of the reeds, The multitude of the bulls, with the calves of the peoples, Trampling under foot the pieces of silver: He hath scattered the peoples that delight in war.

verses.text: To him that rideth upon the heaven of heavens, which are of old; Lo, he uttereth his voice, a mighty voice.

verses.text: Ascribe ye strength unto God: His excellency is over Israel, And his strength is in the skies.

verses.text: O God, thou art terrible out of thy holy places: The God of Israel, he giveth strength and power unto his people. Blessed be God.
